# ComfyUI Bernini Director

The JavaScript files under `web/js` are vendored from:

- Source: https://github.com/AIMixer/ComfyUI_Bernini_Director
- Upstream revision: `6488c961510fc204800160c453e46c6f3a35675c`
- License: Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`)

The files under `scripts` are waoowaoo compatibility shims and are not part of
the upstream project. The upstream modules are otherwise kept intact so UI
behavior and future source updates can be compared reliably.
